Minister Nara Lokesh Discusses Values-Based Education with Cultural Figure

Andhra Pradesh Minister Nara Lokesh met with cultural figure Chaganti Koteswara Rao to discuss the integration of values-based education in schools. The discussion focused on promoting learning centered on ethical principles. Lokesh also honored cultural icons during the event.
